13.description: This vector represents common conjunct consonants and vowel-sign combinations characteristic of the Devanagari script used in Hindi and Sanskrit.

21.description: This vector is related to Hindi consonant clusters and Devanagari script characters.

42.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes and inflections, particularly those ending in the nasal sound 'न' (n).

106.description: This vector represents common Hindi sub-word tokens and character fragments.

170.description: This vector represents sub-word fragments, vowel signs, and consonant clusters characteristic of Indic scripts like Hindi.

199.description: This vector is related to Hindi consonants combined with specific vowel diacritics (matras like 'u' and 'oo').

142.description: This feature vector represents conditional and temporal conjunctions, particularly in Hindi and related South Asian languages, relating to words meaning "when," "if," and "then."

31.description: This vector represents character strings containing variations of the Devanagari retroflex sibilant letter 'ष' combined with various vowel signs and virama.

62.description: This vector is related to Hindi words and syllables containing Devanagari characters.

132.description: This vector represents common Hindi word suffixes and CV/CVC syllable components used in Devanagari text tokenization.
